question: Who became the new CEO of Cellebrite in August 2026?

hits.title: Cellebrite Appoints Shiven Ramji Chief Executive Officer, Succeeding Thomas E. Hogan - Cellebrite
hits.snippet: Cellebrite Appoints Shiven Ramji Chief Executive Officer, Succeeding Thomas E. Hogan - Cellebrite ... ## Cellebrite Appoints Shiven Ramji Chief Executive Officer, Succeeding Thomas E. Hogan ... TYSONS CORNER, Va. and PETAH TIKVA, Israel, Aug. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cellebrite DI Ltd. (NASDAQ: CLBT), a global leader in AI-powered Digital Investigative and Intelligence solutions for the public and private sectors, today announced that Shiven Ramji, who joined Cellebrite as President, Products and Technology in May 2026, has succeeded Thomas E. Hogan as the Company's CEO as part of a planned transition, effective immediately. In addition, Ramji will be appointed to the Company's Board of Directors. Hogan joined Cellebrite as Executive Chairman in August 2023, became interim CEO in January 2025 and was subsequently appointed CEO in August 2025.

hits.title: The Mission Comes First - Cellebrite
hits.snippet: August 13, 2026 | Shiven (Shiv) Ramji, Cellebrite CEO Today, Cellebrite’s Board of Directors announced that I have been appointed Chief Executive Officer. It is an incredible honor to lead this company. I joined Cellebrite only a few months ago, but in that time I have spent countless hours with our people, our customers and our technology. And one thing became clear to me very quickly: the work we do matters. Every day, investigators, forensic examiners, intelligence professionals and public safety leaders around the world take on extraordinarily difficult work. They search for missing children. They investigate violent crimes. They defend nations. They protect businesses. They help bring truth to light and ensure justice can move forward. Our job at Cellebrite is to help them do that work better, faster and with greater confidence. That mission is what brought me here. And as CEO, it will remain at the center of everything we do. I also ... to thank Tom Hogan for his leadership of ... an exceptional leadership ... company and positioned us ... the next chapter. I am grateful for his partnership and for the trust he has placed in me.
